title: Shopify Store Leads, Contacts & Tech Stack Scraper

domains.title: Store URLs or Domains
domains.description: Enter Shopify store domains or full URLs (e.g., 'allbirds.com', 'https://gymshark.com'). Supports bulk lists from Clay, Apollo, or Google Search.

maxContactPages.title: Max Contact/Policy Pages per Store
maxContactPages.description: Maximum number of internal contact, about, or legal pages to scan per store to find emails and phone numbers.

includeProductsAnalytics.title: Extract Product Catalog & Pricing Analytics
includeProductsAnalytics.description: Fetch /products.json to calculate average price, min/max price, product count, vendors, and latest product launch date.

onlyShopify.title: Only Output Verified Shopify Stores
onlyShopify.description: If enabled, non-Shopify websites in your input list will be skipped from the final dataset.

requireEmail.title: Only Output Stores with Emails
requireEmail.description: If enabled, only stores where at least one valid email address was found will be saved to the dataset (saves Pay-Per-Result credits).

concurrency.title: Max Concurrency
concurrency.description: Number of stores to process in parallel.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy settings. Most Shopify stores work without proxies, but proxies help when scanning thousands of domains.
